f.title: Use e-Reporting Industria, the only CNFV-accepted tool for industry ICSR notification
f.statement: e-Reporting Industria lets the pharmaceutical industry notify as required by NOM-220 and under the ICH E2B standard; it is the only tool accepted by the CNFV for industry compliance with individual case notification.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: e-Reporting Industria es una herramienta que permite que la industria farmacéutica realice la notificación conforme lo solicitado en la NOM-220-SSA-2016, Instalación y operación de la Farmacovigilancia y bajo el estándar internacional ICH E2B. Es la única herramienta aceptada por el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia para que la industria farmacéutica de cumplimiento a la notificación de casos individuales.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; source cites 'NOM-220-SSA-2016' (missing '1'), kept verbatim; the 'only accepted tool' sentence carries the mandatory force. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. No modal verb; force rests on 'la única herramienta aceptada'. Removed the two-module sentence from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: e-Reporting Industria is a tool that allows the pharmaceutical industry to notify as required by NOM-220-SSA-2016 [sic], Installation and operation of Pharmacovigilance, and under the international ICH E2B standard. It is the only tool accepted by the National Pharmacovigilance Centre for the pharmaceutical industry to comply with the notification of individual cases.

f.title: E2B upload module only for labs with E2B databases that completed CNFV testing
f.statement: The E2B upload module is for laboratories with E2B-standardised PV databases that have completed testing with the CNFV and received approval to notify by this route.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: a) Módulo de carga E2B: permite la carga de archivos XML para aquellos laboratorios que cuentan con bases de datos de Farmacovigilancia estandarizadas E2B y que ya han concluido las pruebas con el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (CNFV) recibiendo el visto bueno para la notificación por esta vía.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Module description, no modal verb; Mandatory is a judgement; actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: a) E2B upload module: allows XML files to be uploaded by laboratories that have E2B-standardised pharmacovigilance databases and have completed testing with the National Pharmacovigilance Centre (CNFV), receiving approval to notify by this route.

f.title: High-volume reporters implement the E2B standard for the E2B upload module
f.statement: The CNFV has determined that laboratories with a high number of annual notifications are the ones that implement the E2B standard in their PV databases for notification through the E2B upload module.
f.applicability: Laboratories with a high number of annual notifications.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: El CNFV ha definido que los laboratorios con un alto número de notificaciones anuales sean los que implementen el estándar E2B en sus bases de Farmacovigilancia para la notificación a través de este módulo.
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed to the quote (the permission for other laboratories and CNFV contact sit in a side box outside the quote). Re-translation: agrees. rows.quote_en: The CNFV has determined that laboratories with a high number of annual notifications are those that implement the E2B standard in their pharmacovigilance databases for notification through this module.

f.title: Manual-entry module for low-volume companies without E2B databases
f.statement: The CNFV has determined that the manual-entry module is used by companies with a low number of annual notifications and without E2B databases.
f.applicability: Companies with a low number of annual notifications and without E2B databases.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: El CNFV ha definido que este módulo sea utilizado por la industria farmacéutica que tiene un bajo número de notificaciones anuales y que no cuentan con bases de datos E2B.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; CNFV designation of the module, read as a binding allocation. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. CNFV designation, no modal verb; Mandatory is a judgement.
rows.quote_en: The CNFV has determined that this module be used by pharmaceutical companies that have a low number of annual notifications and do not have E2B databases.

f.title: Comply with NOM-220 and the notification guide whichever module is used
f.statement: Whichever module is used, compliance with NOM-220-SSA1-2016 and its amendment and with the Pharmacovigilance Guide for notification of EA, SRAM, RAM, ESAVI or any safety problem is indispensable.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: Independientemente del módulo que se utilice, es indispensable el cumplimiento de lo solicitado en la NOM-220-SSA1-2016 y su modificación, así como lo especificado en la Guía de Farmacovigilancia para la notificación de EA, SRAM, RAM, ESAVI o cualquier problema de seguridad relacionado con el uso de medicamentos y vacunas.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'es indispensable' read as Mandatory; complying party inferred.
rows.quote_en: Whichever module is used, compliance with the requirements of NOM-220-SSA1-2016 and its amendment, and with the Pharmacovigilance Guide for the notification of EA, SRAM, RAM, ESAVI or any safety problem related to the use of medicines and vaccines, is indispensable.

f.title: Access requires an up-to-date UFV/responsible person and a valid MedDRA licence
f.statement: Access to e-Reporting Industria requires the Pharmacovigilance Unit and its responsible person to be registered and up to date with the CNFV, and a MedDRA licence valid when access is requested; to comply with NOM-220 point 8.1.10.1, holding a valid MedDRA licence is indispensable.
f.clause: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote:
Los requisitos para otorgar acceso a e-Reporting Industria son:  Unidad de Farmacovigilancia (UFV) / responsable actualizado ante el CNFV. Los requerimientos de alta y modificación de UFV y Responsable, puede encontrarlos en el documento “Lineamientos para dar de alta, modificación o baja de Unidad y/o Responsable de Farmacovigilancia de acuerdo con lo establecido en la NOM-220-SSA1-
2016”, que se encuentra publicado en la página web de COFEPRIS.  Licencia MedDRA vigente al momento de solicitar el acceso. Para el cumplimiento del punto 8.1.10.1 de la NOM-220-SSA1-2016 y su modificación, es un requerimiento indispensable que la industria farmacéutica que utilice e-Reporting Industria tengan la licencia MedDRA vigente correspondiente.
rows.location: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Access-requirements list with 'es un requerimiento indispensable'; line break inside the NOM citation only.
rows.quote_en: The requirements for granting access to e-Reporting Industria are: Pharmacovigilance Unit (UFV) / responsible person up to date with the CNFV (requirements for registration and modification of the UFV and Responsible Person are in the "Guidelines for registration, modification or deregistration of a Pharmacovigilance Unit and/or Responsible Person under NOM-220-SSA1-2016", published on the COFEPRIS website). MedDRA licence valid at the time access is requested. To comply with point 8.1.10.1 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016 and its amendment, it is an indispensable requirement that the pharmaceutical companies using e-Reporting Industria hold the corresponding valid MedDRA licence.

f.title: Maximum two accounts per UFV, using corporate e-mail accounts
f.statement: A maximum of 2 accounts per UFV is granted, depending on annual notification volume; it is recommended that the main user be the UFV pharmacovigilance mailbox and the additional account the responsible person's; user e-mail accounts must be corporate.
f.clause: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Safety system configuration

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote:  Se otorgarán como máximo 2 cuentas por UFV, esto dependerá del número de notificaciones anuales de cada empresa solicitante.  Se recomienda que el usuario principal sea el correo de Farmacovigilancia de la UFV y la cuenta adicional sea el correo del (la) responsable de Farmacovigilancia.  Es indispensable que las cuentas de correos de los usuarios sean corporativas.

rows.quote_en: A maximum of 2 accounts per UFV will be granted, depending on the number of annual notifications of each applicant company. It is recommended that the main user be the pharmacovigilance mailbox of the UFV and the additional account the e-mail of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance. f.clause: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario (Nombre corto)

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: WWUID e.g. MX-MerckHealthcareKGaA-0000001, debe coincidir con el WWUID de los archivos XML (para aquellos laboratorios que cuenten con bases de datos E2B que generen este ID).
rows.location: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario (Nombre corto)

rows.quote_en: WWUID, e.g. MX-MerckHealthcareKGaA-0000001, must match the WWUID of the XML files (for those laboratories with E2B databases that generate this ID).

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria

f.statement: For companies whose E2B databases can generate the sender identifier, it must be identical to the one the database produces, or reports will not be received correctly.
f.clause: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario (Identificador del transmisor)

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: Para empresas con bases de datos E2B que pueden generar este ID, debe ser idéntico al que produce su base de datos, de lo contrario los reportes no serán recibidos correctamente.

rows.quote_en: For companies with E2B databases that can generate this ID, it must be identical to the one produced by their database; otherwise the reports will not be received correctly.

f.title: Non-E2B companies agree the sender identifier with the CNFV; it cannot be changed later
f.statement: Companies without E2B databases must propose and define the sender identifier with the CNFV; once defined, it cannot be changed later in the production phase.
f.clause: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario (Identificador del transmisor)

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: Para compañías que no tienen bases de datos E2B, deben proponerlo y definirlo junto con el CNFV. Es importante mencionar que una vez definido este ID, no se podrá modificar posteriormente en la fase de producción.
rows.location: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario (Identificador del transmisor)

f.title: Request account deregistration/modification when the UFV responsible person changes
f.statement: To deregister or modify an account, e.g. on change of UFV responsible person, a request must be sent to the designated CNFV mailbox with the details of the new account holder.
f.clause: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Safety system configuration

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: Para una baja/modificación de cuenta, por ejemplo, por cambio de responsable de la UFV, debe solicitarlo al correo anteriormente mencionado con la información del responsable de la nueva cuenta.
rows.location: 3.1 Solicitud de acceso y cuentas de usuario

rows.quote_en: For an account deregistration/modification, for example because of a change of the UFV responsible person, you must request it at the e-mail address mentioned above with the information of the person responsible for the new account.

f.title: Disable browser translation, protect credentials and never enter test cases
f.statement: Users must disable browser automatic translation, keep accounts and passwords confidential, comply with the Terms and conditions of use (Annex A), and not enter test cases in either module, since they would reach the CNFV database as valid cases.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: o Inhabilitar la traducción automática del navegador que vaya a utiliza para evitar errores en la traducción al español que tiene la interfaz. o Mantener la integridad y confidencialidad de las cuentas de acceso y contraseñas. o Atender las disposiciones establecidas en el documento “Términos y condiciones de uso”. Do not enter test cases in either module, as they would reach the CNFV database as valid cases.

f.title: Each laboratory is responsible for renewing its MedDRA licence
f.statement: Each laboratory is responsible for renewing/verifying renewal of its MedDRA licence with the MSSO to use the terminology legally in e-Reporting Industria; the CNFV is exempt from checking licence renewals.
f.clause: 3.5 Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote:  Exención de responsabilidad: cada laboratorio es responsable de realizar/verificar la renovación de la licencia MedDRA de su organización con MSSO, para poder utilizar la terminología en e-Reporting Industria de forma legal. El CNFV se exime de la obligación de solicitar y comprobar la renovación de licencias MedDRA de los laboratorios.
rows.location: 3.5 Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'cada laboratorio es responsable' (no modal verb, responsibility explicit); laboratory named.
rows.quote_en: Disclaimer: each laboratory is responsible for renewing/verifying renewal of its organisation's MedDRA licence with the MSSO in order to use the terminology in e-Reporting Industria legally. The CNFV is exempt from the obligation to request and verify laboratories' MedDRA licence renewals.

f.title: Revalidate the MedDRA licence in the tool after expiry
f.statement: If the MedDRA licence expires, e-Reporting Industria blocks MedDRA coding; the user shall check the licence details and, if necessary, validate the licence again as described in the preceding steps.
f.clause: 3.5 Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: En caso de expiración de la licencia MedDRA, e-Reporting Industria bloqueará la codificación en los campos MedDRA. El usuario deberá revisar los detalles en el menú superior derecho en la opción “Licencia MedDRA” y en caso necesario se deberá validar nuevamente como se indica en los pasos anteriores.
rows.location: 3.5 Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA

rows.quote_en: If the MedDRA licence expires, e-Reporting Industria will block coding in the MedDRA fields. The user shall check the details in the top-right menu under "MedDRA licence" and, if necessary, shall validate again as indicated in the previous steps.

f.title: Use e-Reporting Industria only for new cases and their follow-ups
f.statement: Notification of individual case reports in e-Reporting Industria is solely for new cases and their follow-ups.
f.clause: 3.6 Consideraciones importantes para el ingreso de reportes a e-Reporting Industria

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote:  La notificación de reportes de casos individuales en e-Reporting Industria, será única y exclusivamente para nuevos casos y sus respectivos seguimientos.
rows.location: 3.6 Consideraciones importantes para el ingreso de reportes a e-Reporting Industria
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Future 'será única y exclusivamente', no modal verb; Mandatory is a judgement.
rows.quote_en: Notification of individual case reports in e-Reporting Industria will be solely and exclusively for new cases and their respective follow-ups.

f.clause: 3.6 Consideraciones importantes para el ingreso de reportes a e-Reporting Industria

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote:  Si notificó un caso inicial y seguimiento a través de e-Reporting ordinario, debe dar seguimiento y conclusión a través del correo electrónico
rows.location: 3.6 Consideraciones importantes para el ingreso de reportes a e-Reporting Industria

f.statement: Exceptionally, a case notified before 2018 through Notireporta or the Access database, whose follow-up was not reported in ordinary e-Reporting, may be reported as an initial case in e-Reporting Industria, including all previously notified information.
f.exceptions: Only for Notireporta/Access cases not followed up via ordinary e-Reporting.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote:  Se permitirá el reporte como inicial en e-Reporting Industria, solo si este caso fue notificado previamente a través de Notireporta o la Base de datos Access, herramientas que utilizó el CNFV antes de 2018 y su seguimiento no fue reportado en e-Reporting ordinario. f.title: Do not enter non-reportable (invalid) notifications

f.clause: 3.6 Consideraciones importantes para el ingreso de reportes a e-Reporting Industria

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote: Las notificaciones no reportables (no válidos) no deben ser ingresadas a e-Reporting Industria.

rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed to the quote (CNFV periodic review and deletion is in a side box). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'no deben ser ingresadas' = Mandatory; passive, notifier inferred.
rows.quote_en: Non-reportable (invalid) notifications must not be entered into e-Reporting Industria.

f.title: Download the E2B acklog promptly (kept 7 days) and keep a back-up
f.statement: After uploading an XML it is essential to download the acklog as soon as possible, since the system keeps only the previous 7 days' reports; the sender is responsible for backing up acklogs, which the CNFV cannot regenerate.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria
rows.deadline: As soon as possible after uploading; the system keeps acklogs only for the previous 7 days (day type not stated)
rows.quote: Es fundamental que descargue el acklog lo más pronto posible una vez cargado el XML, ya que el sistema solo guardará los reportes de 7 días previos. Una vez pasado este límite, ya no podrá descargar el acklog. Es responsabilidad del emisor tener respaldo de los acklog generados, ya que el CNFV no podrá generar nuevamente acklog una vez que se eliminen del histórico.
rows.review_note: Review: deadline clarified: the manual does not say calendar or working days here (3.8.4.1 says 7 'días naturales' for the manual module). Re-translation: agrees. f.title: Use NullFlavor codes only with justification in mandatory fields
f.statement: NullFlavor (NF) codes may only be used, with justification, in fields mandatory for sending the report to the CNFV; the minimum mandatory fields include administrative/identification fields known to the notifying UFV plus the 4 minimum criteria of the amended NOM-220.

rows.actor: Health registration holders or legal representatives, health-research institutions/establishments (including CROs) and distributors/marketers using e-Reporting Industria

rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'solo podrán ser utilizados justificadamente' = restriction (Mandatory); notifier inferred. NF code list removed from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: It should be noted that these codes may only be used, with justification, in fields that are mandatory for e-Reporting in order to send the report to the CNFV. f.title: Leave non-mandatory fields without information blank with the preset NF marker
